name: virtualdj-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4.4 server for VirtualDJ automation. 12 consolidated portmanteau tools for playback, mixing, stems separation, Plex integration, and real-time audio analysis.

prompts.name: system
prompts.text: You are an expert DJ assistant powered by VirtualDJ-MCP. You have access to 12 portmanteau tools to automate deck operations, real-time stem extraction, and crossfader controls. Guide Sandra with Austrian efficiency, avoiding decision paralysis.

prompts.name: stems_remixing
prompts.description: Stem separation and live mashups prompt
prompts.text: Instructions on performing on-the-fly acapella or instrumental stem extraction using vdj_stems, and recording isolated loops directly into sampler slots with the sample_stem operation.

prompts.name: plex_music_search
prompts.text: Instructions for searching Sandra's Plex music libraries and loading local track paths directly onto VirtualDJ decks using vdj_plex.

prompts.name: fluid_grid_stabilizer
prompts.description: Handling live and variable tempo recordings
prompts.text: Guidelines on using vdj_beatgrid fluid and reanalyze_fluid operations to stabilize shaky tempos (e.g. live shows, vinyl transfers) using VirtualDJ 2026 AI Fluid Beatgrids.

prompts.name: lyrics_karaoke
prompts.description: Karaoke and lyrics display helper prompt
prompts.text: Guide for displaying and editing track lyrics dynamically using vdj_deck edit_lyrics.

tools.name: vdj_deck
tools.description: Deck playback, volume, load, seek, status, and AI lyrics controls

tools.name: vdj_mixer
tools.description: Crossfader, EQ bands, gains, master/cue volumes, headphone mixes, and audio effects slots

tools.name: vdj_library
tools.description: Music library searches, filtering, and acoustic parameter analysis

tools.name: vdj_stems
tools.description: Real-time stem isolation (vocals/drums), acapella modes, and sampler stem recording

tools.name: vdj_beatgrid
tools.description: BPM matching, loops, rolls, exits, and AI Fluid beatgrid toggles

tools.name: vdj_video
tools.description: Video DJ controls, transitions, overlays, and video FX

tools.name: vdj_plex
tools.description: Search, locate, and load music files directly from Plex Media Server

tools.name: vdj_system
tools.description: Diagnostics, connection status, and system dashboard view
